༄༅/ /cha gsum gtor ma mdor bsdus phrin las 'grub byed bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// cha gsum gtor ma mdor bsdus phrin las 'grub byed bzhugs so//

/bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig cha gsum gtor ma mdor bsdus bya bar spro na/ dkar gtor zlum po gsum snod so sor bshams la chus bran/ skyabs sems sngon du song bas/ mche ba'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra yak+ṣa hūm̐ gis bsangs/ rdo rje me'i rgyas/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la a na la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bhañdza ra ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa kyis gzi byin bskyed/ thal mo khong stong gi rgyas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ gis sbyangs/ stong pa nyid du gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba gsum gyi nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ las gtor ma cha gsum dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsam la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin brlabs/ gtor ma dang po phyogs skyong la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi phyogs skyong 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ gong gi wā ra'i mthar pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ gong gi wā ra'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar sbyar bas mchod/ dbang po gshin rje chu bdag dang*// gnod sbyin me lha srin po'i tshogs// rlung lha dbang ldan nyi zla dang*// gza' skar sa bdag klu rnams la// mchod cing bstod de phyag kyang 'tshal// zhes bstod/ oṃ in+d+ra ya/ ag+ni ye/ ya mā ye/ nai ṛ t+ya ye/ wa ru ṇa ye/ wa ya we/ ku be rā ya/ i sha nā ya/ ud+dhaṃ brah+ma/ sūr+ya tsan+d+ra gra ha nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ pṛ thi wī de wī bhū mi pa ti sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan bdun dang*/ shar phyogs rdo rje can gyi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// gtor ma 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// me dang gshin rje bden bral srin po'i bdag /chu bdag rlung bdag nor gyi bdag po dang*// dbang ldan lha ste 'byung po'i bdag po dang*// steng gi nyi zla tshangs pa chen po dang*// 'og phyogs sa bla lto 'phye chen po bcas// lha rnams kun dang sa steng klu gnyan tshogs// ri yi lha dang gtsang ma'i tshogs bcas la//

sa sa so sor gtor ma phul ba 'di// rab tu dgyes pa'i yid kyis bzhes nas kyang*// rang rang phyogs su legs par bzhugs nas ni// rang gi bu smad mdza' bshes gnyen 'dun dang*// nang mi dmag dang dpung bcas thabs cig tu// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug par bcas// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bsnams nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod/ ces gtor ma phul zhing phrin las bcol/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'byung po rnams la 'bul ba ni+e/ oṃ sarba bhū ta e h+ye hi 'byung po thams cad spyan drangs/ oṃ bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra pad+ma ka ma lā ye s+t+waṃ/ zhes gdan phul/ de nyid kyi wā ra'i mthar ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga /yak+ṣa/ gan+dharba/ a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga /ma nu ṣ+ya/ a ma nu ṣ+ya sa pa ri wā ra na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tha khaṃ ut+ga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ lan bdun dang*/ oṃ bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ lha dang lha min gnod sbyin lto 'phye grul// nam mkha' lding dang 'dab bzang lus srul po// dri za srin po gdon gyi rigs rnams dang*// gang dag sa la gnas pa'i rdzu 'phrul can// bu smad bcas shing g.yog 'khor bcas pa la// bdag gi pus mo sa la btsugs nas ni// thal mo sbyar te khyod la gsol 'debs kyi// gsan nas phan gdag slad du 'dir gshegs shig /rab tu dgyes shing mgu bar gyur nas su// phreng ba me tog dri dang bdug pa dang*// bstod dang gtor ma mar me gus 'bul na// 'di dag gsol zhing legs par bzhes nas kyang*// bdag gi las kyi 'bras bu mchis par mdzod// ces gtor ma phul/ ye dharma dang*/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing*/ sogs kyis chos bshad/ bdag dang sbyin pa'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa sogs mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sngon gyi las dang 'phral gyi rkyen las gyur pa'i 'gal rkyen bar gcod thams cad nye bar zhi ba dang*/

tshe dang bsod nams dpal 'byor thams cad rgyas pa dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par mdzad du gsol/ zhes phrin las bcol/ oṃ sarba bhū ta sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshaḥ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma gsum pa bgegs la sbyin pa ni/ rang nyid khro bo gang yang rung ba'i nga rgyal la gnas pas/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ chos nyid rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang*/ bden pa chen po'i byin brlab kyis bdag sogs sems can thams cad la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i bgegs rigs gang yin pa de dag thams cad gtor ma bzhes pa'i slad du skad cig la 'dir mchis bar gyur cig /oṃ guṅka ri guṅka ri swā hā/ oṃ pi tsi pi tsi swā hā/ oṃ gung gung swā hā/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān e h+ye hi bgegs rigs thams cad spyan drangs/ bigh+nān gṛh+ṇe daṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ nas shapada'i bar gyis mchod/ gang zhig mtshan mo rgyu ba yi// 'byung po rnams dang sha za dang*// srin po sha rjen za ba dang*// sems can rnam pa sna tshogs dang*// ljon shing gel pa sogs gnas pa/ de dang de la gtor ma ni// bza' ba sha chang la phud bcas// 'bras chan 'bras bu mang po dang*| |mchod pa 'di yis mgu byos la// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// sems can rnams la phan pa'i sems// de ring phyin chad bskyed par gyis// rgyan gyis brgyan bzhin du ni chos spyod cing*| |dul zhing yang dag sdom la tshangs par spyod// 'byung po kun la chad pa spangs pa ste// dge slong dge sbyong de yin bram ze'ang de// mtshon chas mi 'jig gang yang med// 'tsho ba'i srog la kun kyang 'dzem// rang gi lus la dpe long la/ gzhan la gnod pa ma byed cig

/ces gtor ma sbyin/ gong ltar chos bshad/ oṃ chen po'am chung ngu gang dag gi// lus la mngon par gnod byed pa'i// nad de nye bar sol mdzod la// gdon khyod rang gi gnas su dengs/ sarba bigh+nān gats+tshaḥ zhes se gol gyi sgra dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol/ slar phyogs skyong la sngar ltar mchod cing bstod nas/ phyogs skyong rnams la 'dod yon tshogs/ de dag thams cad ci rigs pa// 'jig rten khams ni ma lus par// thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig /ces dang*/ yi ge brgya pas nongs pa bshags/ oṃ da sha diklo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥ phyogs skyong rnams rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par gyur par bsam/ bkra shis dang bsngo ba smon lam bya'o// cha gsum 'di'ang tshe 'di don gnyer grong du rgyu zhing yon bdag dang nad pa'i re ba skong ba rnams la ni/ tshig bcad mang zhing gdang snyan pa nyid 'jig rten tshur mthong gi snang ngor legs pa ltar 'ong gi/ tshul des byang chub la nye ba lta zhog /'di ni sgrub pa po phyi ma don gnyer la bar gcod sel phyir thun mtshams su bgyi bar ma tshang ba med pa/ dog bde ba nyid dge sbyor gyi sad du chung ba'i phyir tshig bsdus don tshang ba/ 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pas chu rta dbo'i dkar po'i rgyal ba gsum par/ 'bri chos phyug gi klung pho brang bkra shis tshugs kyi re'u mig lcang lo can rdo rje theg pa'i gan mdzod chen por bris pa dge bar gyur cig/ //sarba maṅga laṃ//
